_README: Every rule here must be transcribed by a human from a clause that is already
ingested in corpus/docs/, and must carry the doc_id, clause number and page it
came from. The calculator discards any rule missing a citation, and reports
NOT DERIVABLE rather than substituting a remembered or 'typical' value.
This file is empty because no regulation PDF has been ingested yet. Populating
it from memory would defeat the entire purpose of the tool.
See rules.README.md for the format and the recommended workflow.
